title: Wide openings and wide dimensions
summary: Reviews in this topic split between praise for wide trunk and door openings and unclear-framed complaints about the vehicle or armrests feeling overly wide in daily use.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the trunk for being wide and the doors for swinging open wide without issues.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention the car and armrests feeling too wide, affecting parking comfort and driving posture, but the small sample limits interpretation.

limitations: The topic mixes different subjects, including trunk width, door swing, overall vehicle width, and armrest width, so it is not a single coherent issue.
Undetermined examples describe possible drawbacks, but their sentiment assignment prevents treating them as clearly negative.
The sample is very small, so examples are insufficient to say more about patterns across vehicles or markets.
